title: Intent Lens — Enemy Intent Preview
description:
See possible enemy actions for the next two steps, with probabilities, and hover an enemy to inspect its action cycle.

[h2]Plan around enemy behavior[/h2]
[list]
[*]Compact previews above enemies show up to two future action steps.
[*]Hover an enemy to see an expanded action diagram with transitions and supported phase conditions.
[*]Native intent icons show damage and multiattacks; smaller percentages show action chances.
[*]Future previews are faded to distinguish them from the current intent.
[/list]

[h2]Probabilities, not guaranteed outcomes[/h2]
Intent Lens shows possible actions based on enemy behavior and public action history. It does not read future random rolls or change enemy decisions. Unsupported dynamic conditions remain uncertain.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
Subscribe to BaseLib and RitsuLib as well as Intent Lens, wait for downloads to finish, and enable the mods in the game's Mod Settings. The SDK is not required.

[h2]Languages[/h2]
English and Russian. The interface follows the game's language, with English fallback.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Version 0.1.1 was tested locally on Windows with Slay the Spire 2 0.107.1, BaseLib 3.4.7 and RitsuLib 0.6.7. Compatibility with newer releases and multiplayer has not been verified.

[h2]Bug reports[/h2]
Include your game and mod versions, enemy name, what you expected and what appeared. A screenshot and relevant log excerpt help diagnose layout or loading problems.
